Upstairs comprises two bedrooms and a fully tiled shower room. The property is within walking distance of local shops and schools, with good travel links nearby. The rear garden provides private outdoor space, ideal for families seeking a straightforward purchase.

This spacious detached house is positioned close to Hindley Town Centre and is offered with no onward chain, making it a reliable transaction. The property requires updating but offers excellent potential, comprising two generous bedrooms, two reception rooms, and a fitted kitchen.

Outside, there are larger than average rear gardens with outbuildings and an additional plot to the rear housing a two-storey garage. There is potential to create off-road parking. The property presents an investment opportunity for buyers seeking a project with good bones and convenient location.

This unique one-bedroom semi-detached house on Leigh Road offers exciting potential for the right buyer. Previously used as a micro bar, it features a distinctive layout with loft room, large yard, and storage containers. The property has been extended from its original terraced form.

Cash buyers only are sought for this chain-free purchase, ensuring a smooth transaction. With 933 sqft of internal space and potential for a two-bedroom conversion or extension, it presents an excellent opportunity for investors or those seeking a versatile living space with growth potential.

This charming two-bedroom semi-detached home is ideally positioned in the sought-after village of Burscough, offering traditional brick-built character with well-proportioned accommodation across two floors. The property features a spacious lounge, second reception room with fireplace, fitted kitchen, and family bathroom.

With an internal area of 1047 sqft, this home presents exciting potential for conversion to three bedrooms. The layout offers excellent scope for modernisation throughout, including the kitchen and bathroom. A low-maintenance rear courtyard garden provides private outdoor space, making it appealing to first-time buyers and investors alike.

The ground floor features a generous double-fronted lounge with bay window, separate dining room, and rear kitchen with yard access. Situated in an established residential area of Moreton, the site offers strong appeal for developers or those seeking to build a bespoke family home. The area provides good local amenities, schools, transport links and convenient access to Wirral's coastline and green spaces.

This modern detached bungalow is being sold by auction and offers excellent quality throughout. Located in a popular cul-de-sac within walking distance of the village and local schools, it features two bedrooms, a bright lounge with large front window, and a fitted modern kitchen with integrated appliances.

The property has been extended to the rear, providing versatile multi-purpose rooms. The main bedroom overlooks the rear garden, while the second bedroom is spacious. Low-maintenance gardens front and rear complete the package. Vacant possession is offered, and early viewing is recommended.
